title: merchant.kyc_failed.v1
description: The KYC/KYB vendor returned a rejection and the merchant moved KYC_PENDING -> KYC_FAILED. Published by Onboarding (BC-3) on pp.merchants.merchant.v1, keyed by merchant_id. KYC_FAILED is not terminal: resubmission returns the merchant to KYC_PENDING and starts a NEW workflow instance, keeping each instance a single auditable attempt. The one exception is SANCTIONS_HIT, which is never resubmittable.

kycReference.description: Vendor case reference only. Never the vendor's raw reason text, which routinely contains personal data.

reasonCode.description: Normalized rejection reason. The merchant-facing message is derived from this code, never from the vendor's own string.

resubmissionAllowed.description: False for SANCTIONS_HIT - a sanctions hit is never resubmittable, and encoding that here means no consumer has to know the rule.

resubmissionCount.description: How many times this merchant has already resubmitted. Rising counts are a fraud signal in their own right.
